offering_description.value: The RMR Group manages commercial real estate investments and properties for publicly traded real estate investment trusts, private investors and property owners. It also provides business management to real estate operating companies and manages commercial mortgage investments through a real estate credit platform.

primary_services.value: real estate investment management; business management; property management and leasing; commercial mortgage investment management; construction oversight

customer_segment.value: B2B: publicly traded real estate investment trusts, institutional investors, commercial property owners and real estate operating companies

end_markets.value: commercial real estate; multifamily housing; hospitality; healthcare real estate; commercial real estate finance

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: ongoing business, property and investment management, with performance incentives under certain agreements; service fees: construction supervision and other property-level services
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes on property portfolios and investment mandates from real estate trusts, property owners and private investors

geography_served.value: US national: commercial property and investment operations across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: real estate investment management, business management, property operations and commercial real estate credit

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: management agreements with real estate trusts, property owners and institutional investors

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: SEC oversight of regulated investment advisory activities and state rules governing real estate brokerage and property management

notes: The current extent of operations outside the United States is uncertain.
